label: I-063-prewarm-bundle
notes: ATTENDED RUN. THE USER MUST BE AT THE KEYBOARD FOR ALL FOUR CAPTURES. The arms differ by exactly one file: the variant overlay is agent-I057-b plus gamedata/scripts/zzz_alao_prewarm.script (lab/mods/alao-prewarm); nothing is replaced and no function is patched. The mod builds ui_inventory.GUI = UIInventory() and calls ui_pda_encyclopedia_tab.get_ui() at actor_on_first_update (frame 7, loading screen still up - the key prompt is at frame ~62), and time-slices ~160 sound_object() constructions for eft_jump_sounds / footstep_sounds onto actor_on_update at a 0.5 ms/frame construction budget, unregistering itself when the queue drains. This is a HITCH comparison, not an fps or ms/frame one: the player drives the workload by hand, so the mean script ms/frame and the fps delta between the arms mean nothing and must not be quoted. SCRIPTED ROUTINE, identical in every capture, exactly as in i058-hitch-request.json: do NOTHING until the 30 s warm-up is over and open NOTHING before the capture starts (the first inventory open of the session must land inside the capture); then (1) open the inventory (I), wait ~2 s, close it; repeat 5 times with ~10 s between opens; (2) open the PDA (P), wait ~3 s, close it; twice; (3) jump 10 times, a couple of seconds apart, on the ground you are standing on; (4) walk ~15 s so footsteps fire; (5) talk to an NPC and leave the dialog twice if one is within reach, otherwise skip and say so. Finish ~30 s before the end and stand still. Read it back with: py -3.12 lab/tools/profile_report.py --queue <id> --listeners --hitch --top 400

pass_conditions.baseline: max 8.4-18.5 ms per capture, and in all four I-058 captures that max WAS the first open (first_ms == max_ms); later opens 3.2-6.4 ms
pass_conditions.variant_expected: max_ms drops to the baseline's LATER-open band, i.e. under ~6.5 ms, and first_ms is no longer the max
pass_conditions.passes_if: variant max_ms <= 6.5 ms in every capture AND variant max_ms is at least 3 ms below the same capture's baseline max. Under the user's bar this row alone is a >= 5 ms cut on three of four I-058 captures.
pass_conditions.fails_if: max_ms is unchanged - then GUI was not built early (check the [alao_prewarm] lines in xray.log) or UIInventory() is not the cold part.

pass_conditions.baseline: max 6.4-9.5 ms, exactly one call per capture above the 0.1 ms floor
pass_conditions.variant_expected: the pda_encyclopedia_tab() singleton is gone from this path; what is left is InitCategories() + SelectCategory + SelectArticle + set_notification
pass_conditions.passes_if: variant max_ms is at least 3 ms below the same capture's baseline max
pass_conditions.fails_if: unchanged - then the singleton is not the expensive part and the cost is InitCategories over all categories, which prewarm cannot remove. Only meaningful in captures where an article actually unlocked; if above_floor is 0 in a capture, that capture says nothing about this row.

pass_conditions.baseline: max 3.5 / 3.1 / 0.9 / 0.9 ms; the first jump of the session was the max in captures 1 and 2
pass_conditions.variant_expected: the sound_object construction is warm, so what is left is the 5 geometry raycasts of get_material(), which this mod does not touch
pass_conditions.passes_if: variant max_ms <= ~1.0 ms (the captures-3-and-4 band) in the captures where the baseline was above 3 ms
pass_conditions.fails_if: still 3+ ms - then the cold cost is per-play, not per-construction, and holding a constructed sound_object does not keep the engine resource. That is the single biggest unverified assumption in this arm.

pass_conditions.row: cb actor_on_land / lst eft_jump_sounds.script:89 and cb actor_on_footstep / lst footstep_sounds.script:87
pass_conditions.baseline: land max 3.0 / 1.2 / 0.8 / 1.2 ms; footstep max 4.5 / 2.7 / 0.9 / 0.8 ms, and its first above-floor call was NOT always its max (capture 1: first 1.76, max 4.45) because each new surface material is its own cold path
pass_conditions.variant_expected: flat: every material's paths were built during the load, so no surface is cold any more
pass_conditions.passes_if: variant max_ms <= ~1.0 ms for both rows in every capture, and the footstep row's max no longer rises when the player crosses onto a new surface

pass_conditions.row: where the prewarm cost shows up
pass_conditions.variant_expected: cb actor_on_first_update gains the UIInventory() + pda_encyclopedia_tab() cost at frame 7 (baseline already 1272-1292 ms there, so expect ~1290-1310 ms), and cb actor_on_update gains a handful of early frames of sliced sound construction
pass_conditions.passes_if: the new listener row lst actor_on_first_update#zzz_alao_prewarm.script:* has first_frame == 7, and NO lst actor_on_update#zzz_alao_prewarm.script:* call exceeds 0.8 ms (budget 0.5 ms of construction plus loop and instrument overhead), and its last call is at a frame below ~62, i.e. before on_loading_screen_key_prompt
pass_conditions.fails_if: the slicer is still running after frame 62 - then the budget or the queue size needs revisiting; or any single slicer call is over 1 ms, which would mean the profile_timer calibration failed and it fell back to the fixed batch (the xray.log line says which).

pass_conditions.variant_expected: one [alao_prewarm 1.0] done block in xray.log per level load, listing the inventory / encyclopedia results, the number of sound paths queued, how many were built and how many FAILED
pass_conditions.passes_if: failed == 0 (or a small number, each one naming a path this install does not ship) and the inventory line says 'UIInventory() built'
pass_conditions.fails_if: 'UIInventory() FAILED' - then building it at first update hits something the constructor needs that is not ready yet, and the hook has to move to on_loading_screen_key_prompt (frame ~62, still behind the screen).
